title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements
author: Ava Patel
description:
Motivation: customers in regulated environments require strict KMS residency enforcement tied to RBAC v2 resource lifecycle, and improved audit logging when region constraints are evaluated. This PR implements enforcement for KMS region pinning at RBAC policy evaluation time, surfaces audit events for policy decision reasons, and provides a migration path for existing policies.

Summary of changes: added region-residency checks to the RBAC v2 enforcer so requests referencing customer-managed keys fail fast if the requested KMS region does not match resource residency constraints; enriched audit events with 'kms_region_violation' and decision metadata; added guardrails in the Private installer to surface warnings during upgrade. Also added unit and integration tests covering enforcement paths and audit event formatting.

Key files changed (high-level): see files_changed field for exact files.

Behavior: when a request includes a KMS key ARN/ID, the enforcer now resolves the key's region (from KMS metadata or request hint) and compares it against the policy's pinned region or residency group. If there is a mismatch and the policy is configured to 'enforce', the enforcer returns a 403 with a structured error_code `KMS_REGION_PINNING_VIOLATION`. If policy is configured to 'audit', the request is allowed but an audit event is emitted with details and severity=warning.

Testing and rollout: unit tests + integration test harness added; deployed to canary Dedicated cluster behind feature flag `rbac_v2_kms_region_pinning` for a week before full rollout. Scripts included to migrate existing policies that used legacy 'kms_residency' boolean into the new structured residency object.

Migration notes: a small migration script (tools/migrations/2024-11-kms-residency-migration.go) will be run by infra during the release window to convert legacy fields. Customers using Private installer will get a preflight warning if they have mixed-region KMS bindings.

Security considerations: enforcement uses KMS metadata and does not transmit key material. Audit events contain key identifiers and region (no plaintext secrets). RBAC policy parsing hardened to reject ambiguous region selectors.

References: Linear ENG-2142, security writeup in #sec-kms-residency, and support ticket SUP-4312 for customer impact.

review_comments: Diego Rivera: Please centralize the KMS region resolver so we don't duplicate region parsing in runtime and installer. Also add a note about fallback when the region is not present in the key metadata.

Ava Patel: Addressed by moving resolver to services/rbac-v2/pkg/enforcer/kms_region_check.go and added a fallback that treats missing region as 'unknown' and triggers audit-only behavior by default. Tests updated.

Samir Desai: The audit payload looks good but we should avoid including full ARN in high-volume logs. Recommend adding a normalized key_id field and truncating the arn in the message.
Ava: Added normalized key_id and added a redaction helper in event_writer.go; CI integration tests updated to assert redaction.

Priya Nair: Can we include a toggle for strict enforcement per-organization? Some tenants asked for gradual opt-in.
Ava: Exposed an org-level flag `enforce_kms_region_pinning` on RBAC policy objects with default=true for new policies. Migration preserves existing enforcement mode where possible.
merge_summary: Squash merged by Diego Rivera after addressing reviewer feedback. All CI checks green. Migration script added and documented. Feature flag `rbac_v2_kms_region_pinning` enabled for canary prior to full rollout.
release_notes:
- Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 resources. Violations return structured 403 with error_code KMS_REGION_PINNING_VIOLATION.
- Audit events emitted for audit-mode policies with kms_region_violation details.
- Migration script included to convert legacy kms_residency fields.
- Private installer adds preflight warnings for mixed-region KMS bindings.
notes_for_ops: Run tools/migrations/2024-11-kms-residency-migration.go during maintenance window; enable feature flag on canary for 7 days and monitor metric rbac.kms_residency.violation_count and audit.event.kms_region_violation. Ensure KMS metadata API rate limits are observed.
